Select distinct compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Join activities to assays on assay_id, assays to target_dictionary on tid, activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno (inner join). Filter target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL284' and assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'. Sort by compound_chembl_id then canonical_smiles.
